title: patch_file failed on spec.skill.md due to substring mismatch on Windows
description: The patch_file call for inserting Phase 9a into spec.skill.md returned 'old_string not found', requiring fallback to write_file with full content. The exact cause is unclear — possible CRLF/LF difference not fully resolved before comparison, or a character encoding issue with the em dash in the heading. The fallback worked correctly but incurred a tool error.
proposed_resolution: Investigate patch_file CRLF normalisation on Windows paths. Ensure em dash characters in headings are byte-for-byte identical between the read result and the old_string supplied to patch_file.
